status_effects.explanation: The narrator is staged as denied confidence and comfort by Albertine on the evenings in question, losing emotional leverage in the relationship even as he longs to embrace her tenderly.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle ne me disait rien et n'avait, d'ailleurs, besoin de me rien dire ; ... le baiser qu'Albertine me donnerait en me quittant ... ne me calmerait pas plus qu'autrefois celui de ma mère, les jours où elle était fâchée
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine withholds her plans and confidence from the narrator, and her parting kiss on these evenings fails to give him the reassurance he seeks, leaving him excluded from her inner life as a participant in the relationship.
